About CAR SMASH OBBY 3D

Smash barriers, dodge giant traps and reach the finish in a car that can fall apart! Conquer 36 obstacle courses across six colorful worlds. Time your run past swinging hammers and crushers, jump gaps and escape giant rollers. Earn coins, collect 10 vehicles and upgrade impact power, speed, armor, grip and suspension. Checkpoints and quick retries keep every attempt short and exciting. Boost into barriers for stronger impacts. Play on desktop or mobile in 10 languages.

How to play

Auto acceleration A D or Left Right steer W Up Space boost S Down brake R checkpoint Escape pause Mobile hold the right-side arrows to steer and the lightning button above them to boost
